# Realized Worth — Regional Campus Series

> A two-day, in-person corporate volunteering, CSR, and employee engagement training in Realized Worth's Transformative Volunteering methodology. 2026 campuses in Washington DC (Sept 24–25) and Atlanta (Oct 14–15), with a two-stage certification pathway for employee volunteer leaders driving community impact.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Program overview, agenda, 2026 cities, pricing, certification pathway, and FAQ for the Regional Campus Series.
- [Business Case](/business-case/): Interactive tool that helps participants build an internal pitch for attending the Campus.
